notes.title: v1.2.0: Huge Content and Features update
notes.content:
[b]New features[/b]

[list]
[*] Daily Puzzle! Try puzzles selected from the DLCs (except the Adult Pack) against the clock. A different puzzle is selected each day. If you can get to seven in a row, there's an achievement that will unlock for you. There's even a new leaderboard of the highest streaks!
[*] User Pack 08. Forty-five new puzzles from players like you. Next pack will be sometime after I have 50 new puzzles submitted. Get creative folks!
[*] Fee Pack 01. Special guest pack by the most prolific creator so far, Fee. Some really great puzzles amongst the 40 included. Don't miss them, and a huge thank-you to Fee for making all these.
[*] Themed background props for the DLC packs. Some are animated, all have random variations. All have perches for Arthur Owl to sit and watch you puzzling away.
[*] A random selection of players who contributed to the User Pack you're playing show up in the background, while the puzzle's creator watches from the side.
[*] Added "Changes requested" as a new status for submitted puzzles.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a few typos (Thanks Fee and HBR)
[*] Added CROWBAR to the Half-Life puzzle. A heinous oversight on my part! (Thanks HBR)
[*] Fixed startup order so that achievements get reported only after your account has been connected. This is to cover a rare case where you got an achievement in the game, but it wasn't reported to Meta/Steam for some reason. When the game starts, it should report all your achievements again. It was always meant to do this, but I didn't realise it was broken.
[*] Fixed volume of intro dialogue. You only hear this once as a new player, so it's gone unnoticed for a while!
[*] Fixed stats if you have the Unlimited Hints DLC.
[/list]

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: v1.1.1 Big content and DLC update
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] New "Unlimited Hints" DLC. Also unlocks user puzzles and lets you start any puzzle you own.
[*] All DLC packs have 5 new puzzles each.
[*] New User Pack 07 with 40 new puzzles from players.
[*] New "Mirror Mode" setting. Mirrors puzzles front to back if that's more comfortable/intuitive for you to read.
[*] Reworked nearly all puzzles up to Medium Pack 02 to be easier.
[*] Arthur Owl talks about mirror mode during one of the tutorial puzzles.
[*] Added a new "Always" letter marking style. This highlights joint letters until they are fully solved.
[/list]
The new letter marking style makes the game quite a bit easier! It's also auto selected if you happen to be playing on the next easiest setting. If you were playing on any other difficulty, it will remain untouched.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

Mirror mode is experimental. The puzzle creator hasn't been changed to work with it yet. If it's popular I'll try to adapt the puzzle creator too. It's a surprisingly non-trivial feature to add, and occasionally it will place certain puzzles too close or too far away on completion. Again, I'll address this if it's popular.

Saved progress for puzzles are separate between mirror and normal mode. If you start a puzzle normally, quit before finishing and turn on mirror mode, then go back into the same puzzle, you'll need to start again. If you don't finish it then switch again, your previous save still exists. Completed puzzles aren't affected at all. In practice, I think pretty much nobody is going to notice how this isn't quite correct!
